title: Foreground Theme
description: Seasonal decoration over the mirror. Put it in Foreground.
help: Shapes that keep moving keep the Raspberry Pi drawing (warmer, and a video beside it may stutter); showers or still shapes cost next to nothing.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: The first theme in the list whose days hold today is shown; move a row up to win where days overlap.
themes.help: Each row is one theme with its own days, shapes, colours and motion. Out of every theme's days nothing is drawn. Standard days: Birthday (on the birthdays under birthdays), New Year (12-31 to 01-01), Easter (palm sunday to easter monday), Midsummer (midsummer eve to sunday), Halloween (10-25 to 10-31), Snow (12-01 to 01-06), Hearts (02-10 to 02-14), Spring petals (04-01 to 05-31), Autumn leaves (09-20 to 11-15).

enabled.title: Show
enabled.description: Off keeps the row's settings but never shows the theme.

people.title: Birthdays
people.description: Whose birthdays: confetti and their name on the day (the Birthday theme).

shower_every.title: Time between showers
shower_every.description: Showers: how often one comes by itself.

shower_on_arrival.title: Move when someone comes
shower_on_arrival.description: Showers: one when the motion sensor sees someone at the mirror.

shower_on_wake.title: Move when the screen wakes
shower_on_wake.description: Showers: one when the screen turns on, this module's schedule begins or privacy mode ends.
